title: Replace a plant registration certificate
summary: You can apply for a replacement plant registration certificate if your original document is lost, damaged, stolen, or contains an error.
intro:
If you did not receive the registration certificate for your plant design or plant item, or it contains a printing error, you can apply for a replacement document from SafeWork NSW.

You can also apply if your registration certificate has been lost, damaged, destroyed or stolen.

Note: If more than one item/design registration document is required you need to pay the applicable fee for each document.
who_can_apply: The registered owner of the plant item or plant design, or their authorised nominee.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application to replace a plant item or design registration'
The registration number (if known), or sufficient details to identify the registration
A letter of authority from the registered owner (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Email or post your application, supporting documents and payment receipt number to the address on the form.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a replacement certificate?
faqs.a: The registered owner of the plant item or plant design, or their authorised nominee can apply for a replacement.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for a replacement certificate?
faqs.a: You need the PDF form, the registration number (if known), sufficient details to identify the registration, a letter of authority (if applicable), and the reason for replacement.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a replacement certificate?
faqs.a: First, download and complete the form. Next, make your secure payment. Finally, email or post your application, supporting documents, and payment receipt number to the address on the form.
